column1: # Lonapse 0.6.0: more lines for the flight events (callouts, power, signal, landing, docking, EVA, stations).

column16: Bien. Ya podéis encender la radio entera.
column17: Good. You can turn the whole radio back on.

column16: Vemos la carga subir. Buen trabajo.
column17: We see the charge going up. Good work.

column16: Copiado. Nada de tostadoras, por favor.
La carga vuelve a estar bien.
Recibido. Apagad lo que no haga falta.
column17: Copy. Turn off what you don't need.
Low power. Turning off the lights.
Good idea. Keep the radio on.
You're running out of charge. Save it.

column16: Control, se me apagan las pantallas.
column17: Control, my screens are going dark.

column16: Poca carga. Hay que buscar el sol.
column17: Low charge. We need to find the sun.
Hello! We can hear you again.
Copy. So good to hear you.

column16: Todo bien. Os echábamos de menos.
Un poquito. No se lo digáis al jefe.
column17: A little bit. Don't tell the boss.
Landing confirmed! Everyone here is clapping.

column16: Que sigan. Nos lo hemos ganado.
Qué bien se está en tierra firme.

column17: Copy. The boat is on its way.

column16: Flotamos. Y nos mareamos un poco.
column17: We're floating. And a bit seasick.

column16: Confirmado. No abráis la escotilla todavía.
column17: Confirmed. Don't open the hatch yet.
Check that it's all still attached.

column16: Ese contacto ha sido brusco. ¿Estáis bien?
column17: That contact was rough. Are you okay?

column16: Copiado. Más despacio la próxima vez.
Todo en orden. Y limpio. Casi.
column17: All in order. And clean. Almost.

column16: Revisión de rutina. ¿Todo bien a bordo?
Control, informe de la estación: todo verde.

column17: Hello, station. Do you need anything?

column16: Control a estación. Os llamamos para saludar.
column17: Control to station. Just calling to say hi.
I don't want to do that again.
Burn in one minute. Get ready.
Heads up, burn time is coming.

column16: Vemos la maniobra nueva. Buena pinta.
column17: We see the new maneuver. Looks good.
